newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Chocolate Products to focus on brewery.
newsitem.headline: Chocolate Products to focus on brewery.

text.p: Malaysia's Chocolate Products Bhd said on Monday it planned to focus more on its brewery operations in China in the future.

Outlook for the beer business in China was bright, with the country's consumption estimated at 20 million tonnes a year, compared to Malaysia's 200,000 tonnes, the company's managing director Tan Onn Poh was quoted as saying by the national Bernama news agency.

Chocolate Products, which has investments in nine breweries in China, plans to increase its production capacity to between 850,000 and 900,000 tonnes in 1997 from 400,000 tonnes currently, Tan told reporters after the company's annual general meeting.
He said the company will invest another 6.0 million ringgit in 1997 as this year to promote its Vico chocolate beverage.
Chocolate Products recorded a pre-tax profit of 34.24 million ringgit for the financial year ended June 30, 1996 against a loss of 3.61 million in the previous year.
